cohort: The study included 970 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) in Al-Qassim, Saudi Arabia, between January and December 2023.
finding: Low birth weight was significantly associated with an increased odds of neonatal mortality among neonates admitted to the NICU.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with neonatal mortality.
followup_time: From admission to discharge from the NICU
birth_weight: Included low birth weight (LBW) neonates (32.7% of the cohort).
gest_age: Included preterm neonates (30.0% of the cohort).
